title: Cozy Vibe Place
description:
This distinctive home features its own unique charm, offering a beautiful setting and a perfect stay for any group visiting the city.

Bedroom 1 (First Floor): 1 single bed and 1 twin bed, with TV (no bathroom)
Bedroom 2 (Third Floor): King bed, with TV and private bathroom
Bedroom 3 (Third Floor): 2 twin beds, with TV and private bathroom

The space
Contemporary townhouse with central AC & a full kitchen near shopping & dining

Find yourself conveniently close to shopping and dining (there's a brewery and a music store right next door) at this stylish, three-story townhouse located just five miles from the heart of Nashville!

This vacation rental features a central, well-equipped kitchen with high-efficiency, stainless steel appliances, leathered granite countertops, and seating for four, a separate coffee bar, and a dining table for mealtimes or game nights. You'll also find a comfortable living area with plenty of seating (including a double sofa bed) and a TV for streaming your favorite channels.

When it's time to call it a night, this townhouse offers three comfortable bedrooms to accommodate up to 10 lucky guests.

Guest access
Keyless entry to the property via keypad. The details for the the keypad code will be sent to you prior to your reservation.

Other things to note

While the neighborhood is mostly quiet and safe this is still an urban environment and you should always remain aware of your surroundings and use common sense. We recommend that you don't leave valuables in your car and don't leave the doors and windows unlocked when you leave the house.
